addr: ECC Rd, Pattandur Agrahara, Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560066, India

rev.t:
A lovely little supermarket located in Whitefield
The parking is tricky as there are only 3 spots so it is a question of if the parking gods are on your side …

Yes truly bad experience. Despite charging hefty prices compared to other main stream Grocery stores, these guys lack empathy towards a customer. Cashier talks so rudely that he wants to charge for the white poly bags as well just asking for an extra bag.

The service is deteriorating day by day.  Sodexo/Pluxee, which was previously accepted on dairy and water cans, has now stopped. The staff at the bill counter have become unfriendly and increasingly rude. …
